takeoff.name: Verel pragondran
takeoff.takeoff_description: Verel Pragondran, cliff take off, be carefull by strong north wind. The begining of fantastic flights.
takeoff.going_there:
From Chambéry, go to 'Chambéry le haut', then Sonnaz, then 'col de Saint Saturnin', then go to left for 500m then right, then left. Keep going until you reach the end of the road, a parking is here to avoid nuisance in the pragondran village.
Enter the village by foot, then a trail is indicated to your left, keep walking for 15 minutes, there you are.
takeoff.comments:
NO FLIGHTS IN VALLEY ! Due to the airport, stay on the cliff from take off to landing at a 1000m maximum altitude.
Over the landing, you should be at a maximum of 50m height to ground (or 350m ASL)
takeoff.weather:
Take off impossible by south wind unless very low wind and very strong thermals.
By North-East or East wind, generally flyable, because protected by the upper cliff, but above 1300m flying conditions might become a bit Rock & Roll

landing.landing_description: Warning, by South wind in the valley, this landing might be uncomfortable beeing on the lee side of "Les Monts", it is then better to land at Brocolis

takeoff.name: Le Sire Sud
takeoff.takeoff_description: Very large and confortable. Possibility for several pilots to take off at once !
takeoff.going_there: From Chambery to "La Féclaz", then "Le Sire" ( signs inside La Féclaz ) Park at the bottom of the only ski lift of this small ski station. Hike for 10 minutes under this ski lift, and there you are
takeoff.comments: By S or SW in winter this summer XC site can transform into a nice soaring site !

landing.landing_description: If South wind is also reaching ground, better use Brocolis and avoid this one

takeoff.name: L'épine - lac d'aiguebelette
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti:1150m after 13h the breeze is coming. Thermic during the afternoon, great flight at the end of the day, over the Aiguebelette lake.
takeoff.going_there: from Chambéry take the highway to Lyon. After the 'L'Épine' tunnel go out (Novalaise/Lac d'Aiguebelette, exit n°12). First crossroad on your left, and another time left immediately. Landing is just behind trees. To go on the takeoff go to the 'col de l'Épine' pass with the D916 road. Just before the pass turn on your left and take a road on 3 km. Follow 'décollage' advertising.
takeoff.comments: good for child, there is a beautiful lake just near the site. No wind and hot water.
takeoff.weather: The takeoff is under the wind if it's coming from the North, NE, E or SE. Still flyable and possible to takeoff by North moderate wind (bellow 15km/h) but be careful by higher wind. By any East component of wind you might find a gentle West breeze at takeoff to let you believe it is fine. Be extra careful, check the wind sock on tree top. You might be able to take off anyway but your flight might be rough and very uncomfortable (even dangerous).

landing.landing_description: near the entrance to the highway, on your right. Be careful, this area is fragile. Pack your glide under the trees, near the parking. Conditions : Unless you happen to be there by strong Est wind ("Le Farou") where you might find uncomfortable lee side landing, it is rarely windy, its position makes it protected from most winds. This landing is also called "the Swamp", if you attempt landing during winter (January to March) you might be displeased by the 10 to 20cm mud waiting for you.

takeoff.name: Margeriaz
takeoff.takeoff_description: Very easy for beginners

takeoff.name: Revard
takeoff.takeoff_description: Not very wide, but because it's a hanggliding site also, it is quite long ;-)
takeoff.going_there: Search for 'le restaurant du revard' on top of the mountain, the take off is 200m from here direction North
takeoff.comments: Nice XC site, from begginers to advance pilots
takeoff.weather: By strong North wind, going to the south just a bit might put you in impossibility to come back, even to the official landing. Better stay North from take off. Webcam: https://www.skaping.com/grandlac/revard

takeoff.name: Montlambert
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti: 890m after 12h thermals and breeze can be strong. Lot's of pilots come here, we thank you to drive slowly and respect the people living on the road to the launch area. This site is fragile! If people complain too much we might lose the right to fly here. So don't unload your car at the turning point on top. Do it when parked further down the road. Respect nature, the people and regulations!
takeoff.going_there: Landing area: from Montmelian, take the N6 road. Turn to the left to 'Saint Jean de la Porte'. Before 'St Jean' turn to the left just after passing a bridge and go along a canal during 1 km. You have to cross a small bridge again. Take off from landing area: at the end of the dirt road turn left. In 'Saint Jean de la Porte' turn left. After 1 or 2 km turn to the right, to Montlambert. In Montlambert turn back and and park your car, but not in the village! Walk 10 mn to the Southwest.
takeoff.comments: This site is closed between mid September to beginning of November, because of an agreement with the local hunters. It is their best moment of joy, so again respect their fun as they do ours! Please inform yourselves about exact days of no-flying. On some days flying is still allowed.
takeoff.weather: With North wind : The only site (with Courtet) where you can fly around Grenoble. But be careful with strong North wind (above ~20km/h) it's just a little protection and the wind can come quite suddenly. Also be careful when flying over ~1400m, the upper mountain protection can stop and you can find turbulences due to being on the lee side. With SW wind or W wind, the take off is on the lee side of the takeoff's West side crest, if wind speed is low (below 10km/h) it might still be okay but not by stronger SW or W wind. With W wind it's flyable, but it might be uncomfortable because of turbulences far above the valley. In doubt, meet pilots on the site for advices.

landing.landing_description:
Alti:270m Be careful about the power line, the trees and the train way. Landing zone is South/South-West of the windsocks! Please look at the information posted at the carpark.
CURRENTLY THE LANDING SITE IS IN DANGER! PLEASE CAREFULLY FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS AND NEVER LAND OUTSIDE THE LANDING FIELD IN THE CROPS OF FARMERS!

takeoff.name: Mont Pelat
takeoff.takeoff_description: Simple
takeoff.going_there: Hike

takeoff.name: Bande
takeoff.takeoff_description:
alti: 926m the landing is far away, be careful. This site is close between may 15 and june 15. It\'s close too between august and september.
Landing CLOSED, and so, take off closed !
takeoff.comments: Landing CLOSED, and so, take off closed !

landing.landing_description: From 'Les Echelles' go to Chambery (N6 road). Just before tunnel Landing CLOSED, and so, take off closed !

takeoff.name: Villaroux "Les vaches"
takeoff.comments: Ouvert lorsqu'il n'y a pas les vaches ni les foins. Obligation de prendre contact avec le club local.

takeoff.name: Le Colombier
takeoff.takeoff_description: This isn't an official takeoff, no windsock or dedicated place. You can virtually takeoff from the whole mountain. Takeoff from the summit
takeoff.going_there: From Aillon le vieux church or from Aillon le jeune (to get back there, you'll need to hitchhike), it's a 2 hours hike with great views

landing.landing_description: Landing in the fields above Aillon-le-vieux church and village

takeoff.name: Saint-Maurice
takeoff.takeoff_description: Déco falaise avec cassure nette. Plutôt un déco delta. La cassure tend à rendre le gonflage est difficile.

takeoff.name: Allevard-St Pierre
takeoff.takeoff_description: coming from the south (grenoble), take on the left when you enter in "St Pierre d'Allevard" village, direction "la Chapelle St Christophe". Walk 5 minuts. alti: 1000m
takeoff.going_there: in Allevard valley.
takeoff.comments: fly other the lake is forbiden. Be carful for the landing: neighbours are ticklish. Don\'t land out of the landing area please!
takeoff.weather: you are under the wind when it\'s north or NW wind.

landing.landing_description: St Pierre d\'Allevard, just on the north shore. alti: 500m.

takeoff.name: Grand Som
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti:1989m From the landing go to 'Saint Pierre de Chartreuse' village and cross it. Take the D102b road to the north ('Saint Pierre d'Entremont' direction) and stop on the 'Cucheron' pass. Walk and follow the sign 'Grand Son' summit during 3h. grass slope just before the summit.
takeoff.going_there: From Grenoble go to 'Le Sappey' village and cross it. Follow the D512 road to 'Saint Pierre de Chartreuse' but turn to the right before it, 'Saint Hugues' direction.
takeoff.comments: With little NE wind you can have soaring on the summit, pretty. Beter season: automn (september to november), before snow. You can have good XC from this site, but it's not the spirit if you walk 3h ;-)

landing.landing_description: alti: 889m Just near the village's cemetery. Pack your wing near the road, watch the local club signs!

takeoff.name: Allevard-Malatrait
takeoff.takeoff_description: short takeoff. Little valley on your left very dangerous with north wind. On your front and right it's all good! alti: 1450m
takeoff.going_there: from 'Allevard', go to 'le Collet d'Allevard', ski station. THe takeoff is on the road's border.
takeoff.comments: the landing area is a little bit technic. Ask to local pilots or to the school. In the school Pierrot is like a bear, but he never bite! :-)
takeoff.weather: in the end of the day very good and mystic restitution on the middle valley. Landing with the night, take your light ;-) Only when it's north wind and sunny during the day.

landing.landing_description: the dike or 'la Mirande' GPS point: the dike, on the south of the lake. alti: 950m

takeoff.name: Allevard-south takeoff
takeoff.takeoff_description: Allevard South
takeoff.going_there: just near 'malatrait' takeoff. When you enter in the ski station (le Collet d'Allevard) take the road on your right, just after a white bilding. follow the road as far as the end.
takeoff.comments:
The takeoff is rather small (only one by one) but you can prepare your wings at the rear.
If you land at the dyke, be careful: it's forbidden and dangerous to fly over the lake. The wind valley could be strong near the ground and you will land in the water...
takeoff.weather: be careful of the gradient in 'la Mirande'. Sometime it's south wind on the takeoff but breeze direction on the landing area...

landing.landing_description: if the south wind is too strong to come back in the dyke, go to 'la mirande' landing. It's on the 'la Rochette' road when you are in Allevard. It's on the border, after La Mirande's lake.

alternate_landing.name: La Mirande
alternate_landing.description: In the event of a too strong South wind, you might not reach the landing in Allevard, this landing is also available (with windsocks)

takeoff.name: Val Pelouse
takeoff.takeoff_description: Park your car at the end of the road, walk 5mn and find a place on the old ski way.
takeoff.going_there: from Chambery go to Pontcharra, cross the village and go to 'La Rochette'. In the village go to 'Arvillard' village. In the village turn left, 'Val-Pelouse' direction. Take-off at the end of the road.
takeoff.weather: thermal site, with high altitude. If it's stable (no thermals) be carreful of wind direction. Attention with moderate to strong South winds!

landing.landing_description: on the 'val-pelouse' road, stop at the 'Molliet' village. Big information board on your right, don't forget to read the rules. Thermals in the LZ, be careful. Be friendly with neighbours, don't fly over their houses.

takeoff.name: Saint Pierre de Chartreuse - La Scia
takeoff.takeoff_description: Two available : West & South West take off should be avoided when ski resort is open. Accessible by road then path, or cable car during winter and july-august. No difficulty, large take off.
takeoff.going_there: look at map and directions on website: http://aec.apinc.org/article.php3?id_article=80
takeoff.weather: Take care with south wind that generally become strong in the afternoon. Take off with north wind sometimes a bit hazardous.

landing.site: Saint Pierre de Chartreuse - La Scia
landing.landing_description: Perquelin, in a small valley east of St Pierre, take care about thermal winds ... Saint Hugues, 5 km south of St Pierre, big landing, sometimes too far with south wind. Pictures on 'Grand Son' site: http://www.paraglidingearth.com/en-html/index.php?site=7255

takeoff.name: Sapenay (south-west)
takeoff.takeoff_description: from landing drive to Chambotte village. In the village turn to the left, D991b rod, direction St Germain. In St Germain turn to the left, D58b road, direction Cessens. Cross it and take D54 road.When the road stops going up a track goes on your left. Park your car along the road and walk 5mn. Little field with trees. on the edge of cliff you can watch the landing area, near the little port.
takeoff.going_there: From Aix les Bains take the D991 road to ruffieux (north). in the end of the lake, few km after Chambotte village, you cross some house with a parking. A sign on the park: \'interdit aux parapentiste\' (forbiden to paraglider). Landing is just in the back of this, in a field but you\'re not authorized to park your car here.
takeoff.comments: With south wind it\'s flyable, the wind get round chartreuse mountain and comes from SW. DON\'T FLY HIGHER THAN 320m ABOVE THE TAKEOFF and all along the crest: airplane airway!
takeoff.weather: don\'t fly with SE, E to NO wind: rotors on the takeoff.

takeoff.name: Chamoux
takeoff.takeoff_description: Small takeoff with nice slope. The take-off is located near the highest point in a valley. So you first have to fly through the valley to get the house-thermal at the beginning of the slope. Lot's of local schools fly there. Good road to the starting place, last 100 meters by foot. Toplanding possible.
takeoff.weather: You have to pay attention to thermic wind at landing, which can be strong in summer (it comes from south).

landing.landing_description: Very large landing field with parking, at left hand site on the road to chamoux sur gelon. (parking is at right hand site)

takeoff.name: Allevard-les Plagnes
takeoff.takeoff_description: on the top of the ski station. go by car to 'super-collet' and take the chair lift (open in winter and July-august). takeoff on the grass, near the ski tow.
takeoff.going_there: Go to Allevard. In Allevard go to the ski station 'le Collet d'Allevard'.
takeoff.comments: verry good site with south wind in winter: a lot's of time in soaring! But be careful in the valley, the wind could be stronger.
takeoff.weather: Don't go down in the little valley under the takeoff (veyton valley), you will have big difficult to go out. No landing :-) If you land at the dike, be careful: it's forbiden and dangerous to fly over the lake. The breeze could be strong near the ground and you will land in the water...

landing.landing_description: the dike or 'la Mirande' as you want.

takeoff.name: Col du Sapenay 'Le Belvedere'
takeoff.takeoff_description: Wooden ramp used by hanggliders, direction west. 897m high.
takeoff.flight_rules: Maximum flying height is 1200m because of ChambÃ©ry airport approach path.
takeoff.going_there: From Chindrieux take the D54 to the Sapenay pass
takeoff.comments: Parking allowed on dedicated parking lot. Do not park on private terrain of 'Le Belvedere'
takeoff.weather: Eastern wind direction is no go. Watch out for strong valley wind caused by Venturi effect with strong north or south winds.

landing.landing_description: Chindrieux. Large grass field at 230m above sea level

takeoff.name: Sapenay (pass)
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti: 897m From landing: drive to Chindrieux. In the village take the D54 road to \'col du sapenay\'. Cross this pass and park your car, there\'s sign \'dÃ©collage parapente du sapenay\'.
takeoff.going_there: From aix les Bains take the D991 road to ruffieux (north). cross Chindrieux and turn to the left a few meters after, on the D57 road. The landing area is on your left (south), along this road.
takeoff.comments: it seems to have a good restitution. With south wind it\'s flyable, the wind get round chartreuse mountain and comes from SW. If it\'s from your right on the take-off, try the south take off (sapenay site). Read the sign on the takeoff to understand local regulation.

takeoff.name: Saint Hilaire du Touvet
takeoff.takeoff_description: North take off is a comfortable big carpet, but may be downwind of the thermic blowing in front. South take off's in grass and you may find more facing thermal wind here than in north take off.
takeoff.flight_rules: You must not climb over 3000m. This flight regulation is due to the Lyon International Airport proximity. Please don't mess with it !
takeoff.going_there: Take off is just near the funicular station in Saint Hilaire village. If you come from Grenoble, cross 'St Nazaire' and go to 'St Pancrasse'. Cross 'St Pancrasse' and turn to the right in St Hilaire village, after the fireman house. The takeoff is under a big chalet. The south takeoff : don't turn after fireman house but park your car on the parking, on your right after 100m. Walk on the track (5mn), take off is on your right. Bus from/to Grenoble (sorry only in french) : http://chvd.org/spip.php?article63 It may be a wise idea to leave the car at the landing site and go up by the funicular. Timetables and prices: http://www.funiculaire.fr/
takeoff.comments: an easy XC: after take off go to the south (your right). Follow the cliff and cross the 'Manival', a little valley. Work the first thermal and go up to the crest of 'Saint Eynard'. Follow this crest to the south until a beautifull old 'fort'. Come back with the same way. After 'Manival' valley you can go up the the 'Dent de Crolles' summit and follow the big crest to 'Le Granier' summit in the north direction. Come back at 'St hilaire' and land near your car :-))
takeoff.weather: be careful with South wind. In spring, conditions can be quite hard, specialy near the cliff.

alternate_takeoff.name: South takeoff
alternate_takeoff.description: grass, and thermal blowing ahead, the exit can be bumpy, stay alarmed.

alternate_takeoff.name: East Takeoff
alternate_takeoff.description: a clean little secret hidden takeoff when carpet is too crowdy. Watch out for wings coming from sides...

landing.landing_description: in Lumbin, in the village's entry when you come from Grenoble. Top landing by north winds (or breeze) near the principal road at the 'syndicat d'initiative', near the big parking.

landing_parking.landing_parking_description: official, try not to keep valuable items visible in your car here...

alternate_landing.name: Saint Nazaire
alternate_landing.description: useful if you drop your car here and hitch hike your way up. useful for noon job-breaks flights and back to office. the landing here can be tricky, as the authorized landing area is narrow, sideways of breeze, and trees are around...

alternate_landing.name: Tourists Office Landing
alternate_landing.description: landing on the plateau. useful if you parked at takeoff..

takeoff.name: La Dent de Crolles
takeoff.takeoff_description: From the 'Col du Coq' pass take the path to the 'Dent de Crolles' summit. It watch you all the time during your walking up.
takeoff.going_there: Like Saint hilaire site, but go to 'col du Coq' pass with your car and park it. If you want big walking, park your car near the Syndicat landing, Saint hilaire village. If you want more ( around 1700m walking up!) park your car in lumbin village.

takeoff_parking.takeoff_parking_description: parking spots on the side of the road, just before you reach the pass

landing.landing_description: you've got choice : Syndicat landing in Saint hilaire village, Saint Pancrasse village, but no official landing, Saint Nazaire village, big flight, Lumbin village, official landing about Saint Hilaire site.

alternate_landing.name: Lumbin
alternate_landing.description: official landing for saint hilaire takeoff

takeoff.name: Pravouta
takeoff.takeoff_description: With thermal you can fly there from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM (in summer). Possible orientations are in between S-E to N-W, best is from S to W.

landing.landing_description: Saint Hilaire du Touvet or Saint Nazaire les Eymes

takeoff.name: Charmant Som
takeoff.takeoff_description: Easy for beginners and tandem

takeoff.name: Sambuy
takeoff.going_there:
No cars are allowed on the ski pistes ;-) You have to go there hiking or with the chairlift.
I'm unsure but this takeoff might be closed during winter season (because the takeoff is on a ski piste) The chairlist opens in the end of June, July and August. Rest of the year, you hike (or go elsewhere) !
takeoff.comments: This takeoff is North oriented, and on top of the ski resort, so North winds or light winds are good for takeoff. I'm unsure but I guess that beeing protected by the Sambuy summit, West wind might not be too problematic

takeoff.name: La Grande Sure
takeoff.takeoff_description: you can find a windsock above the chalet of Jusson. clean grass area.
takeoff.going_there: Park at "pommier la placette" and enjoy the walk !!

takeoff.name: Entrevernes
takeoff.takeoff_description: Very small takeoff in a cu-out of forest, enough for 1-2 wings.
takeoff.comments: A nice place for morning flight, as it is first illuminated by the sun. Normally not flyable in the afternoon when it is in strong downwind.

takeoff.name: Col de Baure
takeoff.takeoff_description: Take-off is prohibited
takeoff.comments: initialy imported from International Leonardo

takeoff.name: Plan de langot
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti : 1200m Park the car at the end of the road of 'La ramaz'. 20 min walk.It's a steep climb!
takeoff.weather: dangerous by north wind or when de 'faverges' breeeze is instaled in the 'tamie' valley.

takeoff.name: Le Grand Ratz
takeoff.takeoff_description:
20 mn by foot from parking at Le Grand Ratz village, over La Placette pass, near Pommiers La Placette, north of Voreppe, 15 km NW of Grenoble
Afternoon and evening take off.
Caution with south wind, not detectable at take off ...
takeoff.going_there: see map and directions on website : http://federation.ffvl.fr/structure/310/sites/38016
takeoff.weather: South wind may be undetectable at take off, and become very strong at landing. You will also fly in dangerous conditions (downwind rotors)

landing.landing_description:
East exit of La Buisse, 5 km W from Voreppe. On the right side of the road when leaving La Buisse to Voreppe.
Very big, no danger...
except with south wind that may become quickly strong ! caution !

landing_parking.landing_parking_description: Please take care of the quiet life of this small village

takeoff.name: Innimond
takeoff.takeoff_description: short and narrow, for experienced pilots. requires some head wind : really too short to be used with no wind
takeoff.weather: Don't fly here with north wind, it can get very bad and dangerous.

landing.landing_description: ONLY in the official LZ, landing elsewhere could KILL the site ! possibility to land on top, see information sign at landing.

takeoff.name: Montgellafrey
takeoff.takeoff_description: Alti: 1790m Grass slope, walk a few minutes.
takeoff.going_there: From Chambery go to Saint Jean de Maurienne. When you are in \'la Chambre\'go on the D213 towards Saint-FranÃ§ois Longchamps. Take a left, before you go up, towards Notre Dame Du Cruet, pass Montgellafrey and continue towards Les Charrieres. The paved road ends but continue on the gravelroad toward the local lake. Hundred meters passed the lake you can walk up the hill for five minutes before arriving at the take-off.
takeoff.comments: good starting for XC, especially during summer and, maybe, automn: high take-off.
takeoff.weather: If you wait too long you will have the valley wind in your back... it\'s more difficult to take-off ;-)

takeoff.name: L'ebaudiaz
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti: 1645m From 'Notre Dame des MilliÃ¯Â¿Â½res' go up to 'Le Moutonnet'. After take the direction 'l'Ebaudiaz'. Takeoff over the park.
takeoff.comments: fly over the airport forbiden. fly over the city forbiden. takeoff is open in begining of May.
takeoff.weather: be careful about breeze, strong in the end of afternoon. be careful about high tension wire.

landing.landing_description: alti 330m Juste near olympic's site, near the 'Gilly/Isere' swimingpool.

takeoff.name: Chalais
takeoff.takeoff_description:
20 mn by feet from Chalais, 5 km east of Voreppe, 15 km NW from Grenoble.
Easy take off!
Landing not visible from take off. Take care about thermal wind in valley : morning site !
takeoff.going_there: Look at map and directions on site : http://aec.apinc.org/article.php3?id_article=1
takeoff.weather: Thermal wind in valley comes quickly with sun : fly there in the morning.

landing.landing_description:
The old landing near rugby stadium has moved to a field near ChÃ¢teau de Beauplan.
Visit landing at first : to check for farming (hay) and thermal wind.
Thermal wind comes quickly with sun and can be strong (from 9:30 to 12:00) then fly there in the morning or in stable conditions.
Flying over national road is vorbidden !
Definitively not a landing for beginners.

takeoff.name: Col de la Madeleine
takeoff.takeoff_description: After TÃ©lÃ©siege of LauziÃ¨re, at the top (2500m), you can take off from South East (morning), or North East (if valley wind).
takeoff.going_there: Col de la Madeleine

takeoff.name: Montmin (Col de la Forclaz)
takeoff.takeoff_description: Alti: 1240m from Annecy go to 'col de la forclaz'. here take the road to the north and park your car after a few meters. Walk 10 mn.
takeoff.going_there: easy :-)
takeoff.comments: good start for XC. You can see some flights with google earth to understand which flights you can have. look at 'view some gpd tracks of flights'.
takeoff.weather: With NE wind it's unconfortable. If nobody fly here, you can ask yourself why. It's the busiest site in France, with St Hilaire du Touvet.

takeoff_parking.takeoff_parking_description: Park your car at "Col de la Forclaz". Only Delta and school can go to take-off by car.

landing.landing_description: Doussard, near the cross road with Annecy and Planfait.

takeoff.name: Prapoutel les 7 laux
takeoff.comments: nobody use this site, exepted professional tandems during winter (skiing season...).

takeoff.name: Annecy - Planfait
takeoff.takeoff_description: during summer holidays, the site/ launch can be very busy.
takeoff.going_there: by car/ hiking; during the summer a shuttle bus is available
takeoff.weather: wx links: - http://www.chamoisvolants.fr/liens-meteo/ - http://www.lespassagersduvent.com/meteo/

landing.landing_description: >> observe/ respect 'no-fly-zones'! (>>> see pix)

takeoff.name: Marlens
takeoff.comments: Rather small take off, 2 wings can take of at a time and not much place to prepare your wing when crowded.
takeoff.weather: This is a low altitude takeoff, you are most likely flying in the breeze layer, any low wind direction will do. If you are flying in winter or Autumn, this takeoff is South oriented, you might not be in a good spot for North wind

takeoff.name: Lac de Crop
takeoff.takeoff_description: park the car where you can see sign to 'lac de Crop'. follow the signs, around 800m. Find a good grass slop and have fun.
takeoff.going_there: from Grenoble go to Brignoud (highway to ChambÃƒÂ©ry). Cross the village and follow 'Laval',then 'Prabert'. Cross it and take a little asphalt road.

landing.landing_description: In the end of the valley, be carreful of the culturs. In 2008/06/11 it was possible to land on the road, see the pictures. Only fot verry good pilots...

takeoff.name: Le Grand Replomb
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti:2450m From landing walk 4h (around 1700m to the summit). Follow the path to 'Jean Collet' refuge. Then go to 'col de la mine de fer' pass but stop at 2100m (sea level). Take to the north, OUT OF PATH, to the summit.
takeoff.going_there: From Grenoble go to Villard-Bonnot village. Cross it and take the road to 'St Murry-Monteymond'. Cross the village and go to the end of the valley.
takeoff.comments: This mountain site isn't for beginners (flying or walking). You ave to know walking out of path!
takeoff.weather: Be carreful of South wind in Belledonnes mountains. Usualy it's not a friendly wind.

landing.landing_description: alti:840m after St Mury-Monteymond village go to the end of the valley, which are some houses: 'La Gorge'. Cross it and take a road to the same direction (end of valley). Park your car near the last field, it's the landing area. Be friendly with neigbourgs, and land out of fields with horses or other. This site ISN'T official.

takeoff.name: Col du Glandon
takeoff.takeoff_description: If it\'s breeze or north: on the neck, just near the road. Walk 5 minuts. If it\'s south wind fly between the \'col du glandon\' and the \'col de la croix de fer\', over the D526 road.
takeoff.going_there: 2 ways for this site: the north road if you come from \'Chambery\' and the south road if you come from \'Grenoble\'. From Chambery take the highway to Albertville (A43-E70). Turn to the right, \'Saint Jean de Maurienne\' direction. Go out at \'La Chambre\' and take a little road (D927) to \'Col du Glandon\', south direction. Park your car in the neck. From Grenoble take the N85 road to \'Vizille\' and \'Bourg d\'Oisans\'. Before this city turn to the left, direction \'Allemont/Vaujany\'. Stay on the D526 road until a few meters. Turn to the left and park your car.
takeoff.weather: Be careful about the south wind, sometimes it\'s bad conditions.

takeoff.name: petit Montaud
takeoff.flight_rules: This is an UNOFFICIAL site (ie. not managed by any club or Federation) : PLEASE use it with great respect to the locals !!!
takeoff.going_there: Park at "Les Maîtres" and keep walking to the takeoff on your left.

landing.landing_description: Don't use it if crops are high !!

takeoff.weather: The breeze is more often than not on the beam at the take off. be careful about breeze, strong in the valley .

takeoff.takeoff_description: mountain take-off, only when the snow is on the ground. In August you will open your glide on the stones.
takeoff.comments: Nice flight, don't wait too late in summer to come here.
takeoff.weather: only with small north wind. If south wind go to 'croix de Belledonne'.

landing.landing_description: next to the car, in the field. Attention to the grass with farmers.

takeoff.name: Montaud
takeoff.takeoff_description: On the road from Montaud to Autrans, before Mortier tunel (road really closed : take off not accessible from Autrans). Montaud village is 5 km south from Voreppe -via Veurey- 15 km NW from Grenoble. Take off is on road side ... no walking ! Impressive for beginners : good slope, not too wide, but no real danger if breeze is present.
takeoff.flight_rules: Please be really respectful while driving across the inhabited places !
takeoff.going_there: from 'Voreppe' direction 'Lans en Vercors'. In 'Veurey', after cross Isere river, take the 'Montaud' direction. drive 5km. Once arrived on the plateau, cross the first residential area then turn right to the sports facilities and park here.
takeoff.comments: Caution, altitude is limited, due to airways : - 1900 m over Bec d'Orient (W of take off), - 2800 m over take off, the limit is between both.
takeoff.weather: While take off is NW oriented, fly there by N or even NE. Take care at NW and avoid W : dangers come from wind along the cliffs, W oriented.

takeoff_parking.takeoff_parking_description: enough room to park on the side of the road

landing.landing_description: Landing in a field with trees on borders... and possible turbulent conditions... Careful when approaching. Please park only at the public parking and walk your way on the reserved path only, Si tu respect to the locals and fields

landing_parking.landing_parking_description: on the public parking, near sports/kids playground

takeoff.name: Le Méruz
takeoff.takeoff_description: Take-off 'Le Méruz'
takeoff.going_there: From Ugine
takeoff.comments: Only 2 or 3 wings can simultaneously take off but the field is wide enough for every one to prepare their wings. Due to the valley breeze, the wind at takeoff is almost allways coming front. Tall trees at end of take off, not exactly beginners friendly...
takeoff.weather:
Usable in almost any flyable conditions but its full potential is unleashed the morning (S-E face). As the day progressed, the valley breeze becomes stronger and stronger, making it harder and uncomfortable to find thermals.
In conditions of strong North wind (NW,N,NE), reaching the upper crest might prove quite uncomfortable (Lee side). You can still escape however lower than the crest, but that's trickier

landing.landing_description: There are 2 possible landings : Marlens or Marthod, but both are hardly reachable by glide only (due to valley breeze) So this takeoff is mostly used for XC. Landing at Ugine is discouraged because grass owners have not shown empathy toward paragliders.

takeoff.name: Le Murier 4 Seigneurs
takeoff.takeoff_description: grass on a hill with trees around.
takeoff.flight_rules: You 're over the Grenoble City's, TMA of 'LE VERSOUD Aerodrome' and be carefull to respect all flying Rules (VFR) on the City here... normal !
takeoff.going_there: 2 ways. From the south of 'Grenoble': cross 'Eybens' and drive until 'Brié et Angonnes'. turn to the left 'Herbey, les Angonnes' direction (road 112). Cross 'Les Angonnes'. In 'Herbey' take on your left (road 112) 'Gières' direction. When you are on the top of the road follow it down and stop your car on a cross road with trachs. Park and walk to your right during 7 mn. From the north: later, or somebody?
takeoff.comments: Good site in the end of afternoon, after your job and if you are too late for fly in Chamrousse. Only with breeze. With wind it's a bad idee. I think it's not a federal site, I don't know the owner. Be quite and peace with neighbourgs :-)

takeoff.name: Le Grand Mont
takeoff.takeoff_description: summit montain, grass slope.
takeoff.going_there: Just before the town of 'Benetant': a 4x4 ride on road 1km, although a steep path on the right begins to climb 700m in altitude to the refuge where you can sleep. (more informations in french here : http://www.refuges.info/point/2350/cabane-non-gardee/beaufortain/chalet-de-chizeraz-ou-chizeruz/ )Then you have 600m to walk to the summit.
takeoff.comments: small report here: http://www.vol-nature.fr/blog/vol-montagne-beaufortain/

landing.landing_description: You can land in the bottom of the valley, near 'Cevins' or 'La Bathie'. You can land in 'Le Villard', on the road to the car park, if you don't want to walk too much. 'Le Villard' is not a easy landing: trees, slope, road, houses.

takeoff.name: Chamrousse - l'Aiguille / la Croix
takeoff.takeoff_description: > l'Aiguille: alti: 1840m; on a little hill, just above 'Recoin' village. > 'la Sapiniere' lies a little lower/ to the NW and is used if 'Aiguille' is in clouds. > la Croix: alti: 2250m; near the cable car, on the sky station summit. good grass shield. 3 take off, 2 landings, 600 m to 1800 m flying .
takeoff.flight_rules: Specific National Park regulations in les Ecrins, starting 15 km SE Overlying the zone between the cablecar/ Chairlift below 300m/ agl NOT allowed!
takeoff.comments: XC: la Croix is often easier to XC start than l'aiguille take-off, especially when inversion is high. Might be big XC start to the East, but it's tough, narrow valleys with wind. it's THE site when you finish your job, at the end of the day. You can make beautifull cross-country in 'Belledonne' mountain, in the north. It's often possible to hitch a ride from the LZ
takeoff.weather: be careful of strong wind, especially NE and SW. http://www.balisemeteo.com/balise.php?idBalise=144

landing.landing_description: 'Saint Martin d'Uriage': alti 550m; looks rather big, but due to the many fences is actually rather small (and tricky if there is lift near the ground)! Near the primary school. Park your car near the gymnasium.

takeoff.takeoff_description: Bisanne Nord
takeoff.going_there: Same access than the South take off
takeoff.weather: When a too strong North wind is blowing, or in the afternoon when the Ugine valley breeze dominate South face Thermals, you can launch from there.

landing.landing_description: Marthod

takeoff.name: Bisanne Sud
takeoff.takeoff_description: alti: 1940m It is near the altitude restaurant. This takeoff is on the top, on the South-East side. Just next to the parking.
takeoff.going_there:
from 'Albertville', go to 'Les Saisies'. You can stop at the landing area. After go to 'Les Saisies' By car : turn to the left when you arrive in this ski station. Keep the road to the end, there is an Altitude restaurant on the top. During winter or sping when there is still a lot of snow (up to around beginning of May), the road to the takeoff is unusable by car, but you can use the chairlift, there are one way tickets for paragliders. During summer (July and August) there are (in 2020 : free) buses that you can use from to go from the Valley (Beaufort or Villard sur Doron) to Les Saisies. Then you can use the chairlift (open in July and August) to reach the takeoff
More info somewhere on there site : https://www.lessaisies.com
In 2020 the information page is here (but it changes every now and then) : https://www.lessaisies.com/bus-albertville-navettes-intramuros-gratuites.html
takeoff.comments:
It might happen that your arrive too late at this takeoff (like 12am or later) and the valley breeze is already blowing from the back (North) Then there is an alternate takeoff (check the map), that can also be used with North wind from which you can still takeoff and reach the south face (in the lee side). Discouraged with strong North wind !
A good idee to go to 'Aravis', in spring. Beaufortain is a good district for family holidays: a lots of differents activities. You can finish your day in 'Le Cormet de Roselend', a soaring site. You will fly until the night with the breeze!
takeoff.weather: Later in the day the breeze might be stronger than the thermals and be coming in your back.

takeoff_parking.takeoff_parking_description: Just a few meters away from the takeoff

landing.landing_description: Landing at "la Pompe" before arriving in Beaufort alti: 700m from Albertville go to Beaufort (D925). Cross 'Villard sur Doron' and stay on the same road. Just after the crossroad (Les Saisies/Beaufort) turn to the left. Landing area is just near a big shed.

takeoff.takeoff_description: alti: 1709m. from parking walk 30mn on the crest to the south. Takeoff on your left, on the top. Just for 1 or 2 glides. big grass Slop.
takeoff.going_there: from grenoble go to sassenage. take the D531 road to Lans en Vercors. Just before Lans take the D106 road on your right, 'MÃ©audre/Autrans' direction. On the 'col de la croix Perrin' take a little road to the north (your right), on the hotel back. Follow it until a refuge (Feneys hotel). Take the road on your right and go to the end.
takeoff.comments: unauthorized site. Only for XC flights: no landing!
takeoff.weather: nothing

takeoff.name: Montgirod-Arcachat
takeoff.takeoff_description:
2000m When you are under the power lines along the road after the cheese farm- go to your right on a 4x4 track and make a judgement on where to launch from off the steeper slope
1900m (GPS co-ords) Normally use this launch on the far SW part of the mountain away from the power lines and easier to access. Go just past the refuge and look for the little wind streamer on the steeper gradient next to some small shrubs, park your car on the corner.
takeoff.going_there: From Moutiers take the N90 road, 'Bourg saint Maurice' direction. After the tunnel go into Centron, then up to 'Montgirod' direction. Go straight up past Montgirod on a little tar farmer road, park by the cheese farm where the tar road ends or go higher if your car can do so. It's about the same distance driving to launch as it is driving up to Forclaz(Annecy) from Doussard, meaning - roughly 15km from Centron to the launch.
takeoff.comments:
XC : This site starts to work early in the year as well as early in the morning. Facing SE with a very steep gradient that has little cow paddocks and forest getting that morning sun this site boasts some good thermalling opportunities. If the wind is N around to W, it is still possible to get flights in before 1pm thanks to its orientation and the micro climate of the Centon/Villette area. However when the valley system works it comes over the top joining the valley wind from Moutiers towards the high mountains from as early as 11am. BUT-It is possible to fly in the afternoon on a stable day trying to fly bubbles on the lee side especially in Autumn/Winter. Despite all meteo winds, every flight at about 10am, there is a light pleasant thermal breeze on launch, with a view of Tignes Grande Motte,Saint Foy,La Rosiere,les Arcs,la Plagne,Val Thorens,Meribel and Courchevel. There are various routes to take once gaining altitude with an early start to your day, some local French pilots have achieved massive distances and return triangles If you are unlucky with the wind or arrive too late-there is a small ridge to fly from that is a good XC starting point for afternoon flying behind the Montgirod side, the launch faces W called Naves.
ACRO : Beware : Centron houses and power lines and main road, fly acro over the trees in the left corner. Fly with a Rogallo or Base system. Minimum 700m in the box with bad wind, max 1000m starting at 1900m. The same distance driving to launch as driving up to Forclaz(Annecy) from Doussard, but the road is smaller, at least tar all the way up. The glide out to the 'box' can also be compared to Annecy at some (2.5 to 2.7km), this is good because most sites in the French Alps used to do 'acro ploufs' require a long glide that eats height.
takeoff.weather:
Spring and Autumn : Hunting season, do not go to the toilet in the trees up the mountain.
Summer: Venturi in the valley.
Winter : foehn wind days-you shouldn't be out there anyway.

landing.landing_description:
Pay attention to farmers cows. The field next to the round-about, you cant miss it, flying out you will see it to the left of the little oval dam across the road, it has rocks cordoning it off with a small streamer closer to the river.
landing down in Centron if the valley wind has established any time after 11am can be hazardous, strong- due to the venturi.
